items.title: Has Demna Solved Gucci's Identity Crisis?
items.summary: BoF's review of Demna's Spring/Summer 2027 show (staged inside a faux flagship store in Milan) calls it a breakthrough, arguing the designer's 'complete palette of personalities' -- rebellious aristocrat, snob, eccentric -- finally gives Gucci a coherent through-line after a year of what the piece calls the brand's 'multiple personality disorder.'

items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear Collection photos and runway review
items.summary: WWD's runway coverage of Gucci's 'The Store Show' in Milan, presenting Demna's Spring 2027 collection inside a full-scale replica flagship with marble, dark timber and bas-relief detailing; set pieces from the show are slated to appear in select Gucci stores worldwide starting next month.

items.title: Gucci's new 'Made in China' sneaker models break with Italian tradition
items.summary: Gucci's Demna-designed 'Drip' sneaker (about $1,000 in the US) and a second slip-on style are labeled 'Made in China,' departing from the house's Italian manufacturing heritage. Berenberg analysts warn of 'tension between provenance and the luxury positioning Gucci is seeking to reclaim'; a Milan consultant is quoted saying 'Made in China is not a good look.'

items.title: Gucci facing backlash over 'Made in China' sneakers while keeping premium pricing
items.summary: Consumer-facing writeup of the Drip sneaker controversy, framing it as Gucci 'getting cheap with production costs' without lowering the price tag; cites a Polymarket X post breaking the news and industry quotes questioning whether the China label undercuts the brand's luxury justification for the price.

items.title: Forum Members Review the 'Vulgar' Gucci Spring 2027 Collection from Demna
items.summary: Roundup of theFashionSpot forum member reactions to the Spring 2027 show, overwhelmingly negative: comments call the collection 'pure vulgarity, paired with an absolute lack of vision,' 'grotesque,' 'a pile of nothingness,' with one poster predicting 'this will be his final season' at Gucci.

items.title: Gucci quality concerns thread
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members compare notes on Gucci leather-goods durability complaints -- stitching separating on straps, hardware tarnishing, edge-paint wear -- feeding into a broader owner debate about whether current construction quality matches price under the Demna-era reset.

items.title: Hypebeast Gucci coverage of Milan Store Show
items.summary: Hypebeast's streetwear-audience coverage of Demna's Store Show, part of continuing tag coverage tracking the Milan collection alongside the brand's parallel product news (Drip sneaker rollout) for a North American youth/sneakerhead readership.

items.title: Kering's $3.9 billion quarter shows Gucci isn't fixed yet
items.summary: Glossy's analysis of Kering's most recent quarterly print notes Gucci sales are still declining group-wide even as North America posted the strongest regional improvement (helped by new product and stronger in-store execution), arguing the turnaround narrative is premature.

items.title: Gucci's Demna blends aristocracy and pop culture at Milan Fashion Week
items.summary: US trade coverage summarizing the Spring 2027 show's mix of 'bourgeois' tailoring and pop-culture styling cues, describing the collection as evidence Demna is building a recognizable, repeatable Gucci vocabulary rather than one-off spectacle.

items.title: Complex Style X post on celebrity Milan Fashion Week attendance including Gucci
items.summary: Complex Style's X post covering celebrity attendance (Trinity and Bryce among others) at Milan Fashion Week including Gucci-adjacent front-row coverage; representative of the social buzz volume around the Milan show week, though the post itself is general MFW coverage rather than Gucci-exclusive.
